body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Panasonic presented its 9.5mm-thick Blu-ray disc drives to personal computer during CES 2008. Even with its 9.5 mm high thin profile, the new BD drive features double speed reading and writing for both write-once BD-R and rewritable BD-RE discs.
The new drive is also compatible with three types of optical discs(BD, DVD, CD). It supports reading and writing on four types of BD media(BD-R, BD-RE, BD-R DL, BD-REDL) and reading of BD-ROMs.
Since Panasonic introduced the industry’s first 12.7mm high internal DVD Super Multi
Drive in 2003, it has continued to pioneer optical disc drive technology by making the
drive’s profile even thinner, to 9.5mm and then to 7.0mm.
